<thought>Based on the observed isotope pattern, a strong M+2 peak at ~33 % of the base peak (consistent with a single chlorine atom’s 37Cl/35Cl ratio) and a noticeable M+1 peak (~16 %) indicating many 13C atoms allow us to definitively identify carbon and chlorine in the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
